title: Row10-S1 Contract/Harness Dry Prep

scenario.same_scenario_rule: Future Path A and Path B must use the same marker, scenario id, exact prompt text, and prompt hash.

s1_proves: written contract for shared Row10 marker and scenario identity
written candidate Path A automated/boundary/API references before host UI
written future real local Cursor UI route with auth/session preflight and browser-login recovery
required future evidence filenames and claim locks
written llm_mvp_core logic ownership and thin Cursor extension boundary
explicit nonclaims for local model backup/export/import/continue-training and out-of-scope runtime/training/lifecycle operations
s1_does_not_prove: Path B Cursor UI was opened, clicked, typed into, or screenshot-captured
Cursor host readiness, visible answer readiness, product readiness, or formal joined pass
token savings, semantic quality improvement, training/learnability, backup/export/import/continue-training, checkpoint promotion, locator update, or lifecycle readiness
absence of all hidden shortcuts in implementation

concrete_candidate_references.status: usable only if a future approved Row10 safe input/path is named
usable only for checkpoint/locator readback guard with production state unchanged

blocked_if_missing: accepted Row10-safe input/path for S4 if S4 is the slice
concrete lifecycle boundary/API interface for S5
concrete locator dry-run/staging boundary/API interface for locator update/reload parts of S6

program_window_preflight: Target real local Cursor, preferably isolated Extension Development Host or Row10 run folder.
Target visible Cursor window for XIIGen Smart Skills extension, not generic Cursor chat, not New Agent, not login textbox, and not unknown/background window.
Record Cursor executable or launcher path, run folder, user-data path, extensions path, visible window title, active target-window control status, and modal/error windows.
If target-window control is not proven, mark BLOCKED_CURSOR_TARGET_WINDOW_NOT_PROVEN.
auth_session_preflight_and_login_recover: Prove signed-in/trusted account state before entering Row10 prompt.
If Cursor opens anonymously, session is lost, logged-out UI is visible, wrong account is visible, or sign-in is required, record LOGIN_RECOVERY_REQUIRED.
Click only a visible enabled sign-in option in deterministic priority order.
Stop before password, token, cookie, one-time code, recovery code, or session secret.
Allow human credential entry outside recorded capture.
Repeat auth preflight and record no secrets captured.
If authenticated/trusted state cannot be proven without secret capture, mark BLOCKED_AUTH_OR_SECRET_SAFE_RECOVERY_NOT_PROVEN.
exact_future_clicks_and_typing: Open or focus the XIIGen Smart Skills panel.
Verify prompt textarea/input is visible as id xiigen-smart-skills-prompt or equivalent visible prompt label inside XIIGen panel.
Paste/type exact Row10 slice prompt containing shared marker and scenario id.
Click button id xiigen-smart-skills-submit or visible Submit button inside XIIGen panel.
Capture the slice-specific visible result screenshot/reference.
Record safe response ref or trace ref only if visible and non-secret.
expected_visible_state: Cursor remains on the XIIGen Smart Skills panel.
Shared marker or safe ref linked to the same prompt hash is visible.
Prompt was not entered into generic Cursor chat, New Agent, login textbox, or unrelated field.
Required screenshot/reference exists, or the slice is BLOCKED_REQUIRED_PATH_B_VISIBLE_EVIDENCE_MISSING.

no_hidden_deterministic_shortcuts: fixture-only, marker-only, source-only, trace-only, schema-only, precomputed, or hardcoded-answer evidence cannot substitute for same-scenario dual-path evidence
future review must reject marker/prompt/hash/request-reference mismatch
future review must reject extension-side business logic, hidden shortcut, or answer synthesis that bypasses llm_mvp_core
local_model_backup_export_import_continu: S1 does not run, prove, or prepare a completed local model backup/export/import/continue-training pass.
S5 may only name later lifecycle evidence after a concrete llm_mvp_core lifecycle boundary/API interface exists.
Any backup/export/import/share/continue-training operation is outside S1 and must remain unclaimed here.

pass_criteria_for_this_s1_packet: Markdown and JSON agree on title, verdict, paths, claim locks, Path A status, Path B status, and next allowed action
contract defines what S1 proves and does not prove
contract names concrete candidate Path A refs or explicit blockers
contract scripts future real local Cursor Path B with program/window/auth/clicks/typing/expected state/evidence
contract keeps all claim locks false
blocked_criteria_for_future_execution: exact prompt text or prompt hash is missing
Path A request/response/trace filenames are missing
Path A interface is not concrete for chosen slice
S5 still lacks concrete lifecycle boundary/API interface
S6 locator dry-run/reload still lacks concrete dry-run/staging boundary/API interface
Cursor target window is not proven
auth/session preflight cannot be proven without secret capture
required Path B screenshot/reference is missing
prompt goes into generic Cursor chat, New Agent, login textbox, or unrelated field
hidden deterministic shortcut, host-side business logic, external AI substitution, or marker-only proof is used
needs_fix_criteria: Markdown and JSON disagree on title, verdict, paths, claim locks, Path A status, Path B status, or next allowed action
S1 wording implies Path A or Path B has already executed
any readiness, token savings, quality, training, lifecycle, checkpoint, locator, runtime, or test claim is opened
future Cursor UI steps are vague or omit program/window/auth/click/type/expected-state/screenshot requirements
no-blocked wording allows execution despite missing exact prompt hash, Path A files, or Path B visible evidence
next_allowed_action: Assign a bounded Row10-S1 contract reviewer for maximum 10 minutes to review only row10-s1-contract.md and row10-s1-contract.json, run JSON parse, Markdown/JSON agreement checks, and whitespace checks. No product execution, Cursor UI, runtime invocation, tests/builds beyond JSON/text checks, code edits, board/status edits, training/checkpoint/locator/lifecycle operations, commit, push, web, external AI, or nested subagents.
